name: michael
description: Grayscale-only theme for grayscale-forced displays and e-ink panels. Single source of truth: all variants derive from these steps. Hex values are gate-derived (see bench/), not hand-picked. Lightness in OKLCH L.

strong.role: kept by judge data: strong vs fg was mud at 4-bit

notes: Text levels are polarity-tuned: mirroring light L values into dark fails WCAG because gamma skews ratios; dark levels were re-derived against the gates.
Adjacent text levels keep dL >= 0.10 OKLCH so grayscale-forced/4-bit screens preserve the hierarchy.
v2: dark strong/fg widened (dL 0.10 -> 0.13) after eval showed types/function_names BROKEN at 4-bit; light fg nudged 0.43.
